title: Embedded Software Sr Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 The PE HMI Team is seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Software Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have 7+ years of experience in Embedded Software Development, with a strong focus on Human-Machine Interface (HMI) systems. This role involves contributing to the design and development of innovative HMI solutions while ensuring high standards of performance, usability, reliability, and security. The candidate will contribute to the architecture, design, development, performance optimization, and troubleshooting of next-generation embedded products, while collaborating closely with platform, system, UX/UI, hardware, and validation teams. Hands-on experience or working knowledge in Human Machine Interface (HMI) and the Automotive domain would be considered a strong added advantage. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Contribute to the design and development of HMI software architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, reliability, and security. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, UX/UI designers, platform teams, validation teams, and product groups, to integrate HMI solutions seamlessly. Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to software engineering best practices and coding standards. Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues related to HMI and embedded systems. Maintain clear documentation of software architecture, design decisions, and implementation details. 
 
 Degree Requirement 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Communication Engineering, or a related field. 
 
 Experience Qualification Expectations 
 7+ years of relevant professional experience in Embedded Software Development. Modern C++ (C++11/14/17) experience. Embedded Linux, Linux internals, and Linux system programming. Proven experience developing and debugging multithreaded and concurrent applications. Memory analysis, performance profiling, core-dump analysis, and system troubleshooting. Experience participating in software architecture, design discussions, and technical reviews. Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, J1939, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, or similar protocols. Familiarity with GitLab, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern software-development practices. Ability to independently own complex technical problems and perform root-cause analysis. 
 
 Technical Excellence 
 Contribute to defining and documenting system architecture for HMI solutions, including software and network components. Apply engineering best practices to improve software quality, maintainability, scalability, and system performance. Stay informed on HMI, embedded software, and automotive technology trends and contribute to innovation in design and development. Apply awareness of software security practices while designing and developing HMI solutions. Experience in industries such as automotive, aerospace, off-highway, or industrial automation is a plus. 
 
 Software Development 
 Participate in quality assurance and engineering processes to ensure HMI system reliability and performance. Collaborate with UX/UI designers to deliver intuitive, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces. Support integration of HMI software with platform, system, hardware, and middleware components. Monitor and optimize system performance using profiling, diagnostic data, and system metrics. Work within Agile development frameworks and contribute effectively to sprint planning, development, integration, and delivery activities. 
 
 Technical Troubleshooting 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Apply a structured and methodical approach to root-cause analysis and resolution of complex system issues. Use appropriate diagnostic, debugging, profiling, and system-analysis tools to troubleshoot technical problems. 
 
 Effective Communications 
 Clear verbal and written communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences. Engage with stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical decisions, and provide project updates. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team. 
 
 Additional information 
 This job requires 5 working days from office.
